name: Lab 12 - AI Observability (LLM call logging, hourly metrics + alerts, error workflow)

parameters.content:
## Lab 12 - AI observability
**A. Log ingestion:** other workflows `POST /webhook/ai-log` (Header Auth) with `{workflow, execution_id, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, latency_ms, status, user_feedback}` -> cost estimate -> `lab.llm_calls`.

**B. Hourly metrics:** Schedule -> SQL aggregates (calls, error rate, p95 latency, tokens, cost) -> thresholds -> alert email (Mailpit).

**C. Error workflow:** set this workflow as the **Error Workflow** in other workflows' settings. Error Trigger -> `lab.workflow_errors` -> alert email.

Credentials: **Header Auth (lab)**, **Postgres (lab)**, **SMTP (Mailpit)**.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO lab.llm_calls (workflow, execution_id, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, latency_ms, est_cost_usd, status, user_feedback) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9) RETURNING id;

SELECT
  count(*)::int AS calls,
  COALESCE(round(avg(CASE WHEN status <> 'ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 3), 0) AS error_rate,
  COALESCE(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms), 0)::int AS p95_latency_ms,
  COALESCE(sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens), 0)::int AS total_tokens,
  COALESCE(sum(est_cost_usd), 0)::numeric(12,4) AS est_cost_usd,
  COALESCE(round(avg(user_feedback)::numeric, 2), 0) AS avg_feedback
FROM lab.llm_calls
WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '1 hour';
